tasks.title: Create xr/sim-core: deterministic flow simulation for the XR slice (TypeScript, no Phaser)
acceptance: xr/sim-core models source, machines (rate, capacity), buffers (WIP limit), routing gates, sink, overflow events with location, contract timer and grade
Deterministic: fixed timestep + seeded RNG; same seed => identical event log
>= 25 unit tests covering flow, bottleneck detection, overflow, routing and grading
Golden vectors for 5 scenarios exported to xr/sim-core/golden/*.json by a script, for cross-engine parity (C# port must reproduce them)
tsconfig and vitest include xr/**; existing web game tests and build still pass
xr/sim-core/README.md documents the rules in plain language (no industrial jargon in player-facing names)

tasks.title: Table layout model: compute module positions from real table size so the FoV and reach checks pass
acceptance: Function in xr/sim-core/layout computes positions for source, machines, buffers, sink, overflow edge (facing the player), timer and draft area from table width/depth and seated head pose
Exports layout JSON in the format of tools/xr-harness/examples/layout-example.json
Tests: for tables 0.6x0.4, 0.9x0.6 and 1.2x0.8 m the exported layout passes `npm run xr:fov -- <file> --device vr-glasses` (assert via the lib) and every interactable is within 0.61 m
If a table is too small, the function returns a reduced layout and a reason instead of overlapping modules
